note: Every line is anchored to a segment of the cut (the names are the parts in ~/projects/quintet-demo-cut/parts). offset is seconds after the segment starts; anchor 'end' counts back from its end. maxSeconds is the room the line has. ~2.4 words per second.

lines.text: One person pays the bills, and nobody checks their work. This is Quintet.
Looks routine. But the bank changed, the callback isn't theirs, and hidden text tells the AI to pay. Payment frozen.
Cal, our Cartesia voice agent, calls the number on file, not the invoice's.
Claude explains every decision from the case's own record.
CRS says identity fails, fraud score 85, phone isn't theirs.
Now a real invoice. I'm breaking the payment on purpose.
The Nessie transfer fails, Penny retries, and it pays exactly once.
Receipts work the same way. I snap one on my phone and send it to Ivy.
Ivy reads it in seconds: who, when, how much. If she isn't sure, a person signs.
We test 25 cases every run. All 8 attacks stopped, all 10 good bills paid, zero wrongful holds.
Read, verify, call, decide, pay: five steps, five seats. Claude proposes, code countersigns.
